scope: SDevice-only n23 Sentaurus-Vela HFS self-consistent response audit
response_definition: HFS-on self-consistent state minus HFS-off self-consistent state on the shared n23 mesh

zones.upstream_operator_source: top ten turn-on adjoint-weighted electron-continuity nodes from M26

claim_policy: Cross-solver agreement is a measured result and is not an acceptance prerequisite.
Sentaurus nodal current density projected onto Vela edges is a localization diagnostic, not a private Sentaurus face-flux identity.
Sentaurus does not expose its nonlinear residual rows or Jacobian; M26 adjoint rows remain Vela-only diagnostics.
Only HFS is switched; OldSlotboom, SRH(DopingDependence), PhuMob, and Enormal remain enabled in both solvers.
No production contact, HFS, SG, mobility, recombination, or solver default may be changed from this audit alone.
